READ MORE ABOUT COMPLETE SECURITY We are a security solutions provider specialising in the development, deployment and management of a wide range of dynamic technology-driven remotely monitored security solutions, services and systems primarily for the construction industry. BACKGROUND Rooted In Security Optiwatch Limited was established in 2015 to provide remotely monitored video surveillance or cctv solutions primarily for the construction industry in London as the demand for more dynamic and cost effective technological security solutions increased. The company has now quickly grown to offer other virtual services like access control, intrusion detection and fire prevention solutions making it a one-stop-shop for all site security and safety solutions. VISION A Secure Environment We aim to provide long term reliable and sustainable solutions that will not only protect all our clients and their assets but also provide a safe and secure environment for them to concentrate on the development of their businesses. We also aim to equip, empower and educate all our clients with all the necessary knowledge and training required to adopt, promote and maintain a solid safety culture for themselves as well as their businesses. AUTHENTICATION Identity Management Users are quickly authenticated, verified and granted effortless access in and out of restricted areas for a specific period of time using remotely or locally registered biometric or card credentials that meet specific site rules and regulations. A real-time monitoring service is established to ensure a stable operational system as user activity is logged, tracked and stored in a database that can be easily accessed by site operators, managers or directors for further detailed event analysis and reporting. AUTHORISATION Automated Access Management Our access control systems are built to quickly receive, efficiently process and accurately authenticate very large volumes of user information in a matter of seconds before sequentially granting necessary access to each user at a time as they present their credentials. Our systems have the ability to authorise up to 30 users per minute as they pass through a turnstile designed to allow one person to go through it at a time. ALERTS Fire Safety Management Advanced battery operated fire and medical emergency alarm systems linked through a secure wireless network are designed to provide a simple, fast and secure method of communicating fire and medical emergencies in complex environmental conditions. The system is composed of automated heat and smoke detectors as well as manual fire and medical call points which are all linked or even extended to a central control unit or base station with full wireless internet connectivity via a series of signal booster links. NOTIFICATION Remote Alarm Management Several units are easily and strategically placed in and around the site to provide an efficient and effective way for personnel to raise instant time-saving alerts that will be transmitted to local as well as remote response units via a stable and reliable RF and 4G network. An unlimited number of units can be added to a single site system to not only cover any scale of crticial indoor and outdoor environments but to also provide easily accessible and reliable means for personel to call for assistance in the event of an emergency. DETECTION Intrusion Management Alarms triggered by potential threats or intrusions on remotely monitored sites are quickly matched to a specific camera location and then flagged up with a corresponding video clip by highly specialised and dedicated hardware and software applications. With advanced false alarm reduction technologies like line crossing and intrusion detection functions, operators are now able to only pick up people or vehicles and maximise their productivity in accurately identifying and managing genuine emergencies. NOTIFICATION Remote Alarm Management Local site patrols are now replaced with virtual guard tours or patrols which can be scheduled, random or in response to a triggered alarm at any time of the day or night even under adverse weather conditions or any other physically limiting circumstances. Cameras may be sequentially placed around the vulnerable areas of the site or along the boundary of a restricted area to create a virtual perimeter that will automatically trigger instant alarms back to the monitoring station for verification when breached. subpages.text: COMPANY About Partnerships SERVICES Video Surveillance Access Control Intrusion Detection Fire Prevention RESOURCES Projects Blog INTRUSION DETECTION Remotely monitored intrusion detection services that use motion sensing infrared systems to detect and instantly notfiy our 24/7 alarm and incident response teams of any potential intrusions. Download Brochure SUMMARY SIMPLIFIED DETECTION We deploy extremely flexible remotely monitored wire free battery operated intrusion detection systems that will easily protect small to medium-sized sites that may not have any power to accomodate more sophisticated security systems. DETECTION Intrusion Management Battery operated wireless motion sensors with an integrated camera are designed to send a video alarm notification clip back to a remote management station via a wireless internet enabled outdoor ready control panel in the event of an intrusion detection. The motion viewers which can be easily placed anywhere around the site use passive infra-red technology to detect motion up to 12 metres away with a 90° view angle. The integrated camera will record in colour during the day and black and white in the night. NOTIFICATION Remote Alarm Management Alarms from the motion viewers with up to 4 years battery life are securely transmitted over a long range encrypted bi-directional radio frequency signal back to a control panel which then transmits the alarm to a remote station via a boosted 3/4G broadband network. Video alarms in the form of 10 second clips can be also be sent to a mobile, tablet or desktop app for instant alarm verification and a verbal warning can be issued over an integrated speaker capable of two-way audio communication to warn the intruders off.
